CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, November 16, 2022
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Axzel Roman, Vice Chairmember  Fabiola Hernandez, Commissioner
Anna Rodriguez, Commissioner  Ana L. Navarro, Commissioner

  Grant Winford,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Tuesday, November 16, 2022 at 6:00 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, gave a brief summary regarding the conduct of the meeting.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Commissioner Rodriguez.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Vice Chairmember Roman
  Commissioner Navarro
  Commissioner Rodriguez
ABSENT
  2 Chairmember Winford
  Commissioner Hernandez

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Commissioner Navarro, to excuse the absence of
Chair Winford and Commissioner Hernandez.

The motion was carried by the following vote:

AYES: 3; Roman, Navarro, Rodriguez
NOES: 0;
ABSENT: 2; Winford, Hernandez
RECUSE: 0;

Motion carried: 3–0–2–0

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

items.

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to hold a Public Hearing and adopt Resolution No. 2022­011 – Recommending
  City Council approve Zone Text Amendment 2022­011, thereby amending Section 18.90.080 of
  the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code and recommend that the City Council adopt an Urgency
  Ordinance amending 18.90.080 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, provided the staff report.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Vice Chairmember Roman, to
  adopt Resolution No. 2022­011, as amended to remove the “Error! Reference source not found”
  from Exhibit A.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Roman, Navarro, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 2; Winford, Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 3–0–2–0

B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA
  That the Planning Commission waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the
  agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have
  been read by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Roman, seconded by Commissioner Navarro, to adopt
  Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Roman, Navarro, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 2; Winford, Hernandez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 3–0–2–0

C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

Commissioner Rodriguez asked about EOS Gym doing construction in back loading dock and asked
how how it affect parking.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke.

D.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, mentioned that a Planning
Commissioners Workshop will be held March 29 – 31 for any interested commissioners.

E.  ORAL COMMISSIONER REPORT(S)

Commissioner Rodriguez mentioned that the City is doing family photo booths for from December 1 – 3.

F.  ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:22 PM to the next meeting to be held
on Wednesday, December 14, 2022 at 6:00 PM.
